rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term when referring broadly to forestry as a field or commercial practice.

example.english: Forestry in Hong Kong is not just logging; it also includes replanting trees.
example.traditional: 香港嘅林業唔止係伐木，仲包括重新種返啲樹。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lam4 jip6 m4 zi2 hai6 fat6 muk6 zung6 baau1 kut3 cung4 san1 zung3 faan2 di1 syu6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is specifically on managing forests, including cultivation, harvesting, and renewal, rather than forestry as a field.

example.english: This job mainly involves forestry, arranging logging, replanting, and inspections.
example.traditional: 呢份工主要做森林管理，安排伐木、補種同巡查。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zyu2 jiu3 zou6 sam1 lam4 gun2 lei5 on1 paai4 fat6 muk6 bou2 zung3 tung4 ceon4 caa4

rows.note: Use this for the academic or scientific discipline of forestry, especially as a subject of study.

example.english: I studied forestry and often had to research tree growth.
example.traditional: 我以前讀林學，成日要做樹木生長嘅研究。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 duk6 lam4 hok6 seng4 jat6 jiu3 zou6 syu6 muk6 saang1 zoeng2 ge3 jin4 gau3
